# 0.5.0 Beta Roadmap & Community Focus (Discussion Seed)

> Copy/paste then adapt. Pin this Discussion. Use it as the canonical async coordination thread for the Beta cycle.

## Why This Matters

We just entered 0.5.0 Beta. Focused, collaborative iteration now will determine the maturity & adoption trajectory heading into the next milestone.

## Core Focus Pillars

- Stability & Quality Gates
- Observability / Metrics
- Security & Trust
- Developer Experience (DX)
- Plugins & Ecosystem
- Memory & Learning
- Federation (Preparation Only)
- Docs & Task Guides

See `docs/BETA_ROADMAP_0.5.0.md` for success signals and tables.

## How to Propose Work

Reply with the template:

```markdown
### Proposal Summary
Area:
Title:
Problem:
Proposed Change:
Impact:
Test Plan:
Owner(s):
Status: idea
```

Maintainers or two community acks (✅) = green light to proceed with a Draft PR.

## Contribution Flow (Short)

1. Align here (avoid duplicate efforts)
2. Open issue (if not existing)
3. Draft PR early (label `wip`)
4. Add/extend tests & docs
5. Ensure gates pass

## Open Threads To Seed (Claim One!)

- Add plugin activation metric & mini guide
- Snapshot replay edge-case test expansion
- Federation threat model outline (prep only)
- Static scan heuristic docs + false-positive examples
- Memory graph consistency micro-test
- Environment validation script (DX)

## Recognition

Roadmap-aligned merged PRs will be highlighted in changelog + release notes.
